summary: Spirit Aviation Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an orderly wind-down of its operations effective May 2, 2026, following its Chapter 11 bankruptcy filings on August 29, 2025. The company will immediately cease filing periodic reports with the SEC under Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act. No specific deal terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed as this is a liquidation rather than a sale. The wind-down requires Bankruptcy Court approval and is subject to risks of objections and cost overruns. Watch for court rulings on the wind-down plan and potential creditor recoveries.
